description:
Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division (NAWCAD), Webster Outlying Field (WOLF), Airborne Systems Integration (ASI) Division intends to issue a competitive, total small business set-aside Request for Offers (RFO) under the SeaPort Next Generation (NxG) Multiple Award Contract for  Airborne Systems Integration (ASI) Technical/Project Management Support (TPMS) . 

 The resulting Cost-Plus-Fixed-Fee task order will provide technical project-management, data-management, and acquisition support for ASI Division requirements. Support includes project planning, execution, monitoring, and closeout; division-level planning and performance reporting; data analytics, metrics, and repeatable best practices. The effort supports multiple defense acquisition programs and weapons systems, including—but not limited to—VH-92A, E-6B, unmanned carrier aviation, counter-uncrewed systems, V-22, and Naval Sea Systems Command Integrated Warfare Systems Program Executive Office requirements. 

 Performance is anticipated at Government sites in St. Inigoes, Maryland, and Patuxent River, Maryland, with limited contractor-site performance within 50 drivable miles of NAWCAD WOLF. A Secret Facility Clearance Level is required.
